title: Rude Machinery
prompt: drum n bass, uk garage, fred again, joy orbison, skrillex
description: A bumpy, bass-led speed garage roller with a growling sawtooth that lurches and leaps through octave jumps, dragged through a breathing filter. The CasioRZ1 kit snaps and skips in 4x4 with gaps, while sparse vowel-filtered stabs ghost in and out like half-remembered vocal phrases. Two peaks rise from a stripped valley — rude, mechanical, unstoppable.
